card.name: Linking words before reform or change events
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as by, or, to, after, since, for, of that sit right before a noun about a later change, amendment, reform, or event. Mostly general web text on law, politics, or history.

modes.label: Before amendment or reform
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction expecting a noun such as amendment, reform, or system change.
modes.example: can only be overturned by subsequent decisions of the Supreme Court or<< by>> constitutional

modes.label: Before a dated event or later period
modes.description: A word like to, since, or after that leads into a dated event, publication, or later stage.
modes.example: Anthrax research was under way prior<< to>> the 2001 biot

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning reform, revision, revolution, and spans of years, mostly Chinese terms.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words when the text is about to name a reform, a revision, or a later point in time.
